Every hash here is full and unabbreviated, and every stored value was read back from the deployed contract on 2026-08-21 rather than transcribed from a console. signer.note: Obtained through the CLI's own BaseAction/getClient path and the OS-keychain cache populated by `genlayer account unlock`. No key was exported, no wallet or keystore was created, and no password was supplied on a command line or written to a file.

liveSourceProof.$comment: The single most load-bearing number in this repository. It answers whether a multi-megabyte authority file can actually be fetched and scanned inside a GenLayer consensus round, which is the product's central risk.
liveSourceProof.note: No size, runtime, fetch-limit or validator constraint was hit. 5,647,099 bytes is byte-exact against tests/prefilter fixtures, and three independent finalized transactions report the same length.

fieldNotes.verdict: On the ASSERTED path `verdict` stores the identity round's cited basis, not a status. Here that basis is the OFAC program code DPRK4 carried by SDN record ent_num 57056. The status is the separate `status` field.
fieldNotes.bond_settled: Correctly false. An ASSERTED finding rests on judgment, so the 0.001 GEN reporter bond stays escrowed until the appeal window closes on 2026-08-28T14:03:52Z or an appeal resolves. Paying a reporter before the subject can respond would defeat the mechanism.
fieldNotes.entry_ent_num: 57056 was re-checked by the contract against the arithmetic candidate set before storage, so the identity round could not name a record outside the evidence it was shown.

strandedValue.cause: GenLayer CLI 0.39.2 `parseScalar` (src/commands/contracts/index.ts) coerces any argument matching ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ into a CalldataAddress. `report` declares `subject: str`, so it received an Address object and `subject.strip()` raised AttributeError. There is no CLI escape hatch: parseArg's JSON branch routes through coerceValue -> parseScalar as well.
strandedValue.whyNotRefunded: StudioNet does not roll back `gl.message.value` when the GenVM reverts. A `raise gl.vm.UserError` is not an EVM revert, so the bond had already moved and stayed in the contract.
strandedValue.howToVerify: `stats.balance` is 2000000000000000 wei while the only determination holds a 1000000000000000 wei escrowed bond. The 0.001 GEN difference is this stranded transfer.
strandedValue.recoverableWhy: The contract has no sweep or admin-withdraw path, which is deliberate -- an owner who can move escrowed bonds is a worse problem than a stranded 0.001 GEN of simulated network value. The amount is recorded here rather than written off silently.
strandedValue.contractDefectWhy: The contract's input validation behaved correctly and rejected a malformed subject. The value loss is a property of the CLI's argument coercion combined with StudioNet revert semantics, not of contracts/Recourse.py.

ci.note: CI runs on every push, so commits after the one named here have their own runs. This run is recorded because its npm ci steps are the first to report 0 vulnerabilities in place of the 3 high-severity findings, on both operating systems.

notProvenOnChain: The ADDRESS path. The only live attempt failed for the CLI-coercion reason recorded under strandedValue, so no live ADDRESS determination exists and none is claimed. The path is covered by direct tests against the production screen() code.

The appeal lifecycle. `d1` is appealable and its window is open until 2026-08-28T14:03:52Z, but no appeal was filed and no live adjudication occurred. All three appeal dispositions are covered by direct tests only.
